description: Source code for a WPF/UWP user control 'EquationStylePanelControl' managing line style and color selection for graphing equations, including dependency properties, style handling, and UI interaction logic.

classes.name: EquationStylePanelControl
classes.description: A user control for selecting line style and color in a graphing calculator application.

methods.name: EquationStylePanelControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing style options and component.

methods.name: GetLinePattern
methods.description: Returns a line pattern as a DoubleCollection based on the line style.

methods.name: GetLineAutomationName
methods.description: Provides an automation name string for a given line style.

methods.name: GetColorAutomationName
methods.description: Returns an automation name string for a given brush color, considering theme and high contrast.

methods.name: SelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles color selection changes from the UI.

methods.name: OnSelectedColorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when SelectedColor property changes.

methods.name: ColorChooserLoaded
methods.description: Initializes color selection when color chooser UI loads.

methods.name: SelectColor
methods.description: Selects the UI element matching the given color.

methods.name: OnSelectedStylePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when SelectedStyle property changes.

methods.name: SelectStyle
methods.description: Selects the UI element matching the given line style.

methods.name: StyleChooserBox_SelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles line style selection changes from the UI.

methods.name: StyleChooserBox_Loaded
methods.description: Initializes line style selection when UI loads.
